name: Mage Slayer (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): The slayer is trained to recognize spellcasters and their spells and tools. The slayer gains Knowledge (arcana), Spellcraft, and Use Magic Device as class skills. Additionally the slayer uses his Intelligence modifier, rather than Charisma modifier, with Use Magic Device checks.

Advanced Options: Slayer Talents & Lethalities ©2014, Rogue Genius Games. Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
